picks.title: Google Stitch Uses Gemini 3.8 Flash to Turn Brand Assets Into UI Designs
picks.excerpt: Google Stitch now uses Gemini 3.8 Flash to read dropped-in brand kits and product shots, auto-extract a design system and styling, and generate brand-consistent marketing and product page layouts.
picks.rationale: New feature in a mainstream AI UI tool: brand kit in, extracted design system and on-brand layouts out, which changes how designers kick off UI work.

picks.title: You Can Edit Your Photos With Lightroom and Photoshop Inside Google Gemini
picks.excerpt: Adobe's Photoshop and Lightroom editing tools now run inside Google Gemini, letting users make color, lighting and retouching edits to photos conversationally without opening Adobe apps.
picks.rationale: Concrete integration shipped: Adobe's core image tools usable conversationally inside Gemini, a new route for quick retouch and colour work.

picks.title: Designing an AI Photo Editor Around a Capability Contract
picks.excerpt: A product-design case study on structuring an AI photo editor's small upload-prompt-generate interface around an explicit 'capability contract' so users know what the model can and cannot do.
picks.rationale: Reusable AI-UX pattern: telling users up front what the model can and cannot do, which designers can apply directly to generative features.

picks.title: Blender always scared me, but Claude helped me make this animated video in just a few hours
picks.excerpt: A Blender novice uses Claude to drive Blender and produce a short 3D animated video in a few hours, showing how AI assistants lower the barrier to 3D tools.
picks.rationale: Hands-on demo of an agent driving Blender end to end; shows non-3D designers a practical route into 3D motion work.

picks.title: "We have the kind of stuff AI wishes it could make": Why trust is more important than ever for the NASA brand
picks.excerpt: NASA creative director David Rager on keeping the agency's brand trustworthy when AI-generated imagery floods the feed, and why authentic assets are now a design advantage.
picks.rationale: Credible brand-design view on keeping authentic assets as an advantage when AI imagery floods the feed; fresh interview from a major creative director.
